note: Alberta Parks recreation area beside Lundbreck Falls on the Crowsnest River, off Hwy 3A about 25 km NW of Pincher Creek: a treed main loop in a river bend and an open powered loop to the east, plus 13 walk-in tent sites. Sites 31-35, 53, 55 and 58 back onto the river behind a fringe of trees and a riverside trail. No firewood sold. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the Alberta Parks page (updated May 28, 2026), shop and tear sheet: unserviced C$28 (14), power (15/30 A) C$36 (26), walk-in tent C$28 (13); vault toilets, no water; reservable May 8 - Sep 29; max 61 ft. Sites and season (manual) match. Riverfront -> riverview recommended; walk-in count 12 -> 13 in the note.
flags: WATERFRONT (stored riverfront - recommend riverview): the shop tags RV sites 31, 32, 33, 34, 35 (unserviced, 28-51 ft), 53 (power, 35 ft pull-through), 55 (power, 51 ft) and 58 (unserviced, 50 ft) 'Near Water', plus tent sites 16-20 and 57. On imagery the nearest pads on the main loop's north and west edges are ~15-35 m from the Crowsnest River (channel ~30-40 m wide), but a continuous line of trees stands on the bank and the tear sheet draws a riverside hiking trail between the loop and the water; the clearing on the north bank is the fishing access, not a pad. No pad has open ground to the water (tree screen), so on-water fails; the river is visible/adjacent through the fringe from those eight sites. The east power loop (sites 1-15) is 50+ m from the river behind a conifer belt. If the reviewer reads the fringe as thin, the alternative is riverfront with a caveat naming 31-35, 53, 55, 58.
